d:
Gold Rush takes a tough turn as Todd Hoffman hits rock bottom when a key crew member quits after seven seasons, leaving his mining operation in trouble. Meanwhile, Tony Beets gives rusty old equipment a new purpose as he transforms it into a monster power barge. And with his own challenges weighing on him, Parker Schnabel ends up missing his birthday. With every crew facing a different setback, who will manage to keep pushing forward?
Watch Gold Rush, Season 7, Episode 10, on Discovery Channel India.
